configs.title: Rt:Core Boost
configs.author: sirpips (original: Luis Torrão)
configs.description: Stable 15 FPS config for RG4xxx. Lowers virtual CPU clock, uses JIT core, cuts internal resolution to 66%, OpenSLES audio backend.
configs.raw_content:
# GLME01 - Luigi's Mansion
# Rt:Core Boost
# sirpips (original: Luis Torrão)
# Stable 15 FPS config for RG4xxx. Lowers virtual CPU clock, uses JIT core, cuts internal resolution to 66%, OpenSLES audio backend.

[Core]
Overclock = 0.60000000
CPUCore = 4
CPUThread = True
DSPHLE = True
SkipIPL = True

[Video_Settings]
InternalResolution = 0.66666667
NoMipmapping = True
Backend = OpenSLES

[Video_Hacks]
VISkip = True
FastDepthCalc = True
DisableFog = True
SafeTextureCacheColorSamples = 128
